title: Cultural Awareness in Vision-Language Models: A Cross-Country Exploration

bias_targets.methodology: A 'Retrieval across Countries' task that evaluates which specific countries Vision-Language Models (VLMs) associate with images of diverse individuals, personal traits, and physical characteristics.

Pairing images of individuals from six major racial groups (East Asian, White, Middle Eastern, Latino, South Asian, Black) with country names and personal trait prompts (e.g., honest, lazy, criminal) to uncover stereotypical geographic and behavioral associations.
Using images categorized by specific physical attributes (skinny, obese, tattooed) to analyze how VLMs culturally link body types and physical appearances to specific nationalities.
Using images categorized by age-related attributes (young, old) to analyze how VLMs associate different age groups with specific countries.
